classification.difficultyReason: Find a linear inverse and represent the function, inverse and reflection line together.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Sketch the graph of $y=f(x)$, $y=f^{-1}(x)$ and $y=x$ on the same Cartesian plane.

answer.short:
$y=2x-1$, $y=\dfrac{x+1}{2}$ and $y=x$.

The function and its inverse are reflections in $y=x$; all three lines pass through $(1,1)$.
answer.worked: Draw $y=2x-1$ through $(0,-1)$ and $(1,1)$. Reflect it in $y=x$ to obtain $y=\dfrac{x+1}{2}$, through $(-1,0)$ and $(1,1)$. Include the line $y=x$ on the same axes.

spec.description: One Cartesian plane with the original line, its inverse, the dashed reflection line and the common point (1,1).
spec.mathematics: Original line y=2x-1; inverse line y=(x+1)/2; reflection line y=x. Intercepts and the common point are exact.
